fields.Name: T106 - Knowledge Hub Analytics
fields.Description: Opens the Knowledge Hub Analytics screen once, then verifies its sections (section-rail navigation + KPI drill-down, and the Tags co-occurrence recompute) via checkpoints. Consolidates old T261–T262.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Knowledge Hub app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo) and click 'Analytics' in the left nav (fa-chart-line icon). Then walk these sections IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) analytics-drilldown — confirm the Overview section renders its KPI cards and widget grid, then click a different section in the left-nav rail (e.g. Tags or Quality) and confirm the main content swaps; back on Overview, click a KPI card and confirm a drill-down detail panel opens (with a table or a 'No data available' empty state); (2) cooccurrence-recompute — open the 'Tags' section and scroll to the 'Frequently Paired Tags' (co-occurrence) sub-section, click the 'Recompute' button, and confirm it enters a Computing/disabled state and afterward shows the co-occurrence table with tag pairs OR a valid 'No co-occurrence data' empty state. Keep going until both sections have been visited. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait for content rather than navigating away.

checkpoints.name: analytics-drilldown
visualCriteria: The Analytics Overview renders KPI cards and a widget grid, switching sections in the left-nav rail swaps the main content, and clicking a KPI card opens a drill-down detail panel (table or valid empty state)

checkpoints.name: cooccurrence-recompute
visualCriteria: The Analytics Tags section shows a 'Frequently Paired Tags' area with a Recompute button, and clicking Recompute enters a Computing/disabled state and then shows the co-occurrence table or a valid empty state
